title: In These Our Days So Perilous
altTitles: Grant Peace, We Pray, in Mercy, Lord
Grant Peace in Mercy, Lord, We Pray
author: Latin; Martin Luther (1483-1546)
credit: Latin c. 6th century, adapted by Martin Luther, 1529.  Translated to English by Richard Massie, 1854, alt.
firstLine: In these our days so perilous,
verses: In these our days so perilous,
Lord, peace in mercy send us;
No God but Thee can fight for us,
No God but Thee defend us;
Thou our only God and Savior.
